skill.name: brag-slim
skill.description: Create a short launch video from a local project or website. The skill plans scenes, reuses product visuals, adds audio, and prepares sharing assets.
skill.summary: Produce a polished launch video, poster, storyboard, and share copy from a project or website.
skill.author: latent-spaces

security_audit.summary: All 20 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or benign production guidance. Separate semantic review found medium-risk instructions for broad local tool use, rendering project components, and retrieving arbitrary websites and assets.

remediation.issue: The skill can open user-supplied websites and download their assets.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before network access, block private and local addresses, enforce size limits, and restrict downloads to approved media types.

remediation.issue: Rendering real project components can execute build hooks or component initialization code.
remediation.suggestion: Use an isolated environment without secrets, disable lifecycle scripts, and ask before running project-defined commands or importing executable components.

remediation.issue: The skill permits unspecified local tools and creates several output files.
remediation.suggestion: List required tools and commands, constrain writes to the output directory, and request approval before using any additional executable.

content.user_title: Create a Short Product Launch Video
content.value_statement: Turning a project or website into a concise launch video requires research, storyboarding, motion, audio, and export work. This skill coordinates that workflow and creates sharing assets.
actual_capabilities: Inspects a local project or public website for product copy, visuals, styles, and key user flows.
Creates a scene-by-scene launch video plan with hooks, highlights, timing, and a closing message.
Supports landscape, vertical, and square formats with a configurable target duration.
Applies preset or freeform tones such as polished, cinematic, deadpan, or app-store.
Produces a rendered MP4, poster image, share copy, and retained working files.
Reviews scene and transition stills for overflow, collisions, readability, and contrast.
limitations: Results depend on the media, browser, rendering, and audio tools already installed on the machine.
Dynamic, authenticated, protected, or consent-gated websites may not capture accurately.
Importing project components can run project code and should occur only in an isolated environment.
Users must verify branding, factual claims, asset licenses, music rights, and final visual quality.

use_cases.title: Showcase a New Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a focused product update into a short video that demonstrates the entry, key action, and result.

use_cases.title: Present a Portfolio Project
use_cases.description: Create a polished overview that uses the project's real interface, visual identity, and strongest interaction.

use_cases.title: Prepare Social Launch Assets
use_cases.description: Generate a platform-ready video, poster frame, and concise caption for a product announcement.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 20-second landscape launch video for this project using the default tone. Focus on what it does and who benefits.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a complete video with sensible defaults.

prompt_templates.title: Highlight One Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vertical launch video focused on [feature]. Show the user action and result, then write matching social copy.
prompt_templates.scenario: A product owner needs a focused feature announcement.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Brand Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a square video for [URL] using a polished tone. Preserve its colors, typography, copy, and real product flow.
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs a brand-consistent social video.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Advanced Campaign Cut
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 22-second cinematic video for [project]. Use [audience], [core claim], and [feature sequence]. Verify every transition and avoid unsupported claims.
prompt_templates.scenario: An experienced team provides campaign strategy and detailed creative constraints.

output_examples.input: Create a polished 20-second landscape video for our analytics dashboard.
output_examples.output: A restrained four-scene video introduces the dashboard, demonstrates filtering, reveals the result, and closes with the product name. Delivery includes a poster and caption.

output_examples.input: Make a vertical launch video for the new export feature.
output_examples.output: A mobile-format video opens with the export problem, shows the real interaction, confirms completion, and ends with a direct release message.

output_examples.input: Create a deadpan square video from our public website.
output_examples.output: A calm three-scene video uses the site's actual typography, concise claims, generous spacing, quiet audio, and a settled poster frame.

best_practices: Provide one product, one audience, and one primary message for each video.
Confirm network access, local commands, and project code execution before production begins.
Review factual claims, asset rights, readability, audio levels, and final exports before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not request invented metrics, testimonials, customer quotes, or product capabilities.
Do not expose private repositories, credentials, internal sites, or unpublished assets during capture.
Do not overload a short video with many features, long paragraphs, or rapid unreadable scenes.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill accept?
faq.answer: It accepts a local project in the current directory or a public website URL.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: It supports landscape, vertical, and square output at 30 frames per second.

faq.question: What files does it produce?
faq.answer: It produces an MP4 video, a poster image, share copy, a plan, and retained working files.

faq.question: Can I choose a creative tone?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a preset tone or provide a clear freeform direction that overrides the preset.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Website inputs require network access. Local projects may also reference remote fonts, images, or other resources.

faq.question: Does it guarantee publication-ready output?
faq.answer: No. Review claims, licenses, branding, accessibility, audio, and platform requirements before publishing.
